data.name: reach
data.title: Accounts reached
data.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen this story, at least once. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your story by the same accounts. This metric is estimated.

data.name: views
data.title: Views
data.description: The number of times your story was played or displayed

data.name: replies
data.title: Replies
data.description: The number of replies you received from your story, including text replies and quick reaction replies.

data.name: shares
data.title: Shares
data.description: The number of shares of your story.

data.name: follows
data.title: Follows
data.description: This is how many accounts started following you.

data.name: profile_visits
data.title: Profile Visits
data.description: The number of times your profile was visited.

data.name: total_interactions
data.title: Story interactions
data.description: The number of replies and shares for your story.

data.name: link_clicks
data.title: Link Clicks
data.description: The number of taps on links in your story.

data.name: navigation
data.title: Navigation
data.description: This is the total number of actions taken from your story. These are made up of metrics like exited, forward, back and next story.
